clinical_features.symptoms:
signs of dehydration 
Analgesia 
* NSAIDs 
-  Diclofenac Sodium (only if no renal impairment) 75 mg IM stat or 
IV infusion over 30 min or 
- Indocid suppositories 
* Opioid  
- Fentanyl 1/kg IV or 
- Morphine 0.1mg/kg IV 
Anti-emetic 
- Metoclopramide 10 mg IV stat 
Observe in ED for intractable pain/vomiting after above Rx 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Criteria for Admission & Urgent Urology Referral 
* Urine infection 
* Urosepsis 
* Acute kidney injury 
* Hydronephrosis 
* Bilateral obstruction 
* Obstruction in pregnancy 
* Anuria 
* Intractable pain / vomiting 
* Obstruction of solitary / transplant kidney

Discharge Criteria 
* No infection 
* No hydronephrosis 
* No renal dysfunction 
* No intractable pain/vomiting 
Discharge Management 
* Encourage oral fluid intake of 2.5l/day 
* Analgesia x 5/7 
- Paracetamol 1g QID po 
- Diclofenac 25-50mg TDS po 
- Tramadol 50-100mg TDS po 
* Antiemetic 
- Metoclopramide 10 mg TDS/PRN po 
 
Urology OPD follow up
